match.diff: AssertionError: Can't find ability to activate command: @actN {N}, Exile this card from your graveyard

ruling: Oracle: '{6}, Exile this card from your graveyard: Create two tapped 1/1 colorless Robot artifact creature tokens with flying.' The ability functions only from the graveyard (CR 113.6k, 602.1). XMage builds it as a SimpleActivatedAbility without Zone.GRAVEYARD, so it exists only on the battlefield and can never be activated; gorge offers it from the graveyard. Forge AGREES with gorge. Filed magefree/mage#16480. Operator-approved xmage_wrong 2026-10-13.
source: Spider-Slayer, Hatred Honed (activate#0.0); operator approved xmage_wrong 2026-10-13 (Forge AGREE); a shape ruling because a per-row ruling on a harness row is dropped by every replay (MergeVerdicts carries only diverge signatures). Scoped by its diff to an activation costing {N} plus exiling the card from the graveyard that XMage can't find so a real driver gap for other graveyard activations (e.g. Say Its Name) stays visible.
